newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin says still working as active president.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin says still working as active president.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin, scoffing at talk that he was not in charge of Russia, said on Thursday that people should not rush to take down pictures of their leader which traditionally hang in government offices.
"The country has a president and an active president at that," said Yeltsin, who is in hospital while doctors prepare the ground for an operation on his heart.

Yeltsin, speaking clearly but slowly in a radio address, said he was in touch with events in Russia, despite the time-consuming preparations for his operation, which will improve the blood supply to the heart.
Yeltsin, 65, had two heart attacks last year and doctors say he may have had a third between the two rounds of the presidential election.
The brief address touched on all aspects of Russian political life, including the situation in Chechnya and in the far east and among the cash-strapped armed forces.
